# One name per thing, part 2: screenshots

Screenshots for #6817 part 2. Every record in them is synthetic: the pages
are the real Dashboard pages, drawn by the offline Profiles fixture
(`packages/E2E/Profiles`) in headless Chromium.

| File | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `before-profiles-overview.png`, `after-profiles-overview.png` | Products → Profiles at 1280 pixels. The breadcrumb, the page title and the side menu's section said Profiler, and the products menu said Performance Profiles. They all say Profiles now. |
| `before-profiles-overview-phone.png`, `after-profiles-overview-phone.png` | The same page at 390 pixels, where the side menu folds into "Navigate to". |
